id: title:benjackwhite:restore session drag to command center

review.posthog_relevance: Adds drag-and-drop support for task items in the Desktop app command center, including MIME type handling and drag-start event assignment.
review.reason: The observed changes implement drag-and-drop support for task items, including MIME type handling and drag-start event assignment, while explicitly excluding canvases. This is a substantive, bounded capability improvement.
review.uncertainty: The review is based solely on supplied observations; no unverified outcomes or adoption are inferred. The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation and its relevance to the Desktop app command center workflow.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No abstention.

observations.behavior: Adds drag-and-drop support for task items while excluding canvases.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop app command center workflow: P1.F1.H1 checks that dragging a task sets the correct MIME type and copy behavior, while P1.F2.H3 explicitly disables draggable on canvas items.

observations.behavior: Adds DragEvent type and drag-start handler.
observations.posthog_connection: P1.F2.H2 implements the drag-start handler that assigns the task ID to the data transfer, while P1.F2.H3 attaches this handler and the draggable attribute to the DOM element.
